name: dox-populi-viewer
description: Browser viewer for the private Screeps server, built on the ISC-licensed @screeps/renderer. Serves fully offline: renderer, metadata, and images are nix-vendored; nothing proprietary.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --sourcemap --outfile=dist/main.js && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && rm -rf dist/assets && cp -r node_modules/@screeps/renderer-metadata/images dist/assets
